title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products
title.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products. Be it Enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Court convened:

status.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products. - AS INTRODUCED

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
